digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge applier, inbound link ADD path
propositions: Every reconcile pass re-attempts and logs warnings for the same structurally-impossible inbound link writes (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) because failed links never record a LINK event and are re-emitted identically
The applier's warn-and-continue error handling has no durable memory of permanent failures, so the bridge never converges and carries a permanent error floor of 200+ doomed writes per hour

A new ImpossibleLinkStore with deciding digests over structural inputs (endpoint status, parent chain, dependency set, or global projection for cycles) must durably record permanent failures and skip re-attempts until those inputs change
The impossible_links.json store must be committed to the tickets branch by reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot so records survive process restarts and CI checkouts between passes

Endpoint fingerprints must cover the full parent chain to account for resolve_hierarchy_link redirecting to type-tier ancestors, and cycle records must key on the global projection to detect intermediate unlinking that breaks cycles
